cohort: 1335 women giving birth at Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, divided into two groups: those over 35 years of age (Group A) and those between 20-34 years of age (Group Y).
finding: Advanced maternal age pregnancies are associated with increased incidence of maternal medical disorders, cesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, and adverse perinatal outcomes, including low birth weight, large-for-gestational-age babies, NICU admissions, and preterm births.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in the advanced maternal age group compared to the younger group.
